title: 실제 예측·관측 결과와 재배치 수량·동선을 연결하는 결과 화면

plan.question: Can the user follow recorded observed stock through an unchanged causal forecast, score and explicitly assumed shadow quantities/route without confusing field outcomes?
plan.hypothesis: Evidence bundle and results UI preserve frozen model/data provenance and causal separation with zero engineering acceptance failures; optional OSRM failure remains explicit.

prior_art.title: OSRM official API documentation
prior_art.verified_scope: 2026-11-01 original General options and Table/Route sections: static extracted profiles, directed seconds, GeoJSON and errors.
prior_art.difference_to_test: Wire actual station coordinates and a bounded road-time request to existing H15 shadow planner; not truck/legal/traffic verification or routing-method novelty.

data.observed_truth: Previously issued H13 forecast and separately collected future API, recorded September metrics; H14/H15 saved results
not_observed: Real relocation actions or counterfactual inventory
Real fleet, depot, parking capacity and measured travel/handling

evaluation.success_rule: zero acceptance failures, complete linked evidence bundle, all checks reported; road availability not a prediction or field-effect success criterion
evaluation.failure_rule: any provenance or display semantic error is not_supported; missing road adapter is reported blocked and never replaced by invented values
evaluation.exclusion_rule: All original supported issued rows retained; invalid future is null and excluded only from displayed scoring. No best-example selection after truth.
evaluation.uncertainty_plan: Engineering deterministic evidence checks; reuse original score uncertainty as labeled, no new independent accuracy or causal claim.
evaluation.seed_plan: No fitting or new particle generation; use original128 cached particles, deterministic selection and routing tie-break.
